instruction: How many qualifying purchase invoices does this customer have, and do they meet the repeat-customer definition? Explain in two sentences.
context: Fictional teaching scenario, not Online Retail findings. CustomerID: DEMO001. Three product rows have InvoiceNo values INV100, INV100 and INV100. All rows are non-cancelled purchases with positive quantities and unit prices. Define a repeat customer as an identified customer with at least two distinct qualifying purchase invoices during the recorded period.
target: Customer DEMO001 has one distinct qualifying purchase invoice, so they do not meet the repeat-customer definition during the recorded period. Three product rows on the same invoice count as one purchase invoice, not three.
